notes.environment: BuddyPress classic templates are NOT active on this BuddyNext install (no #buddypress DOM, no /activity/ #whats-new-form; plugin list has no 'buddypress' entry). BuddyNext runs its own hub/feed system (body class bn-hub-feed) and its own parallel media lightbox (bn-lightbox__*) that visually intercepts clicks on top of WPMediaVerse's own Interactivity-API lightbox (mvs-lightbox-*, present and correctly wired in the DOM -- data-wp-bind--aria-pressed, role=group aria-label=Reactions -- but not what the user actually sees/clicks). All C/D rows keyed to '(BP active)' or classic BuddyPress composer markup were marked skipped/not-applicable rather than pass or fail: untestable in this environment, not proven broken.
notes.grid_thumbnail_size_finding: C.member.grid-thumbnail-size / D.grid-thumb-size-default: REST GET /mvs/v1/media returns mvs_size=large in thumbnail_url even though mvs_thumbnail_size resolves to its 'medium' default (option row absent from wp_options -- confirmed via direct mysql query against the live web DB, bypassing the known wp-cli wrong-DB risk). This is NOT a regression: SettingsHelper::get_grid_thumb_size_key() (includes/Core/SettingsHelper.php:144) was deliberately changed in 1.8.0 to always serve the 'large' rung for grid/masonry tiles regardless of the configured medium/full setting, for HiDPI/retina crispness, with an mvs_grid_thumb_size_key filter as the escape hatch (see the method's own docblock). The runbook's C.member.grid-thumbnail-size and D.grid-thumb-size-default rows still describe pre-1.8.0 behavior and need a wording update to match the intentional 1.8.0 change. Not filed as a bug -- code-level review confirms this is working as designed.

notes.scope_caveat: This pass prioritized: (1) the release-critical private-community gate (section D) -- verified fully end to end, every assertion passed (anon 401 on REST with option ON, anon 302-to-/login/ on /media/, /media/@user/, /media/battles/, anon 401 mvs_community_private on mvs/v1 and mvs-pro/v1, logged-in grid renders every image with no broken icons, signed /serve URL works both with and without cookies per the pre-signed model, toggle restored to 0 and web-confirmed); (2) representative smoke across anonymous surfaces (explore, search-empty, tag-empty, single-media redirect, album), member lightbox/reactions a11y, signed-URL cache headers, and the categories REST OPTIONS/PUT contract; (3) admin page fatal/console checks (Overview, Settings, All Media, Pro Competitions Dashboard) -- all clean; (4) a 390px mobile pass on Explore/My Media/Messages -- no horizontal overflow, clean single-column layout on all three. Deep interactive journeys requiring real writes -- upload, delete, full album/collection lifecycle, DM send/receive, moderation flow, battles/challenges/tournaments full play-through, cron-bounded batch jobs, cloud storage migration, watermarking, AI moderation -- were not executed this run and are recorded as skipped, not pass. No fixtures were created (verified wp-cli fixture cleanup found none pre-existing), so no teardown was required beyond restoring the private-community toggle.
